q: Do hand tools exported from Jalandhar fall under EU CBAM?
title: Jalandhar hand tools and CBAM
short: No. Hand tools such as spanners, pliers and hammers are classified in Chapter 82, which is not in Annex I of the CBAM Regulation. Only iron and steel goods in Chapter 72 and headings 7301 to 7311, 7318 and 7326 are covered, so check the CN code your EU customer declares.
audience: Hand tool and forging exporters in the Jalandhar cluster of Punjab

ul: Chapter 72: iron and steel, including semis and flat or long products.
7301 to 7311: structures, tubes, containers and similar.
7326: other articles of iron or steel.

p: Buyers may still want a footprint per tool for their Scope 3. Keep forging fuel, electricity and steel purchase records so one can be built.

senseible: Senseible reads the energy invoices behind the making stage into a fingerprinted Scope 1 and 2 record, and keeps material invoices on the Scope 3 trail. Material factors come from your supplier or a named database and are labelled with their source, so the product figure can be traced line by line.
